segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Call Center, this is Ava. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: I think I need to cancel my follow-up appointment. I cannot keep missing work.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I understand. Missing work is stressful. Can I ask what time windows are easiest for you?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Early morning might work, but I am not sure the appointment is even worth it.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Your follow-up helps the care team catch issues early. I can look for an earlier slot and confirm transportation options.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: If you can find something before work, I would probably keep it.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Call Center. What medication question can I help route today?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: This new medicine makes me dizzy. I am thinking about stopping it.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I am sorry that is happening. Please do not stop a prescribed medication without clinical guidance.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: I just feel off and I do not know if that is normal.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I can connect you with a nurse to review symptoms and next steps. Are you having trouble breathing or chest pain?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: No chest pain, but I would like to talk with a nurse.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Call Center, this is Ava. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: I got a bill I do not understand. If this is how it works, I am done with these visits.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I hear how frustrating that is. Let us separate the billing question from the care you still need.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Nobody explained why I owe this much.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I can route the billing review and keep your care plan moving while that is checked.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Okay, I just do not want to be surprised again.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thank you for calling Call Center. Tell me what is going on today.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: My chest feels tight and I have been short of breath since this morning.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I am sorry you are feeling that. Because you mentioned chest tightness and shortness of breath, I need to escalate this right away.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: I was hoping it would pass, but it is getting worse.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: If symptoms are severe or worsening, please call emergency services now. I can also get a nurse on the line immediately.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Please get the nurse. I am scared.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Call Center, this is Ava. What can I help with?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: I was discharged yesterday and I do not know who I am supposed to call next.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I can help organize the next step. Do you have your discharge paperwork nearby?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Yes, but it is confusing.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No problem. We can confirm your follow-up appointment, medication questions, and who to call if symptoms change.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: That would help a lot.
